pre_condition: stream is a readable file-like object whose repeated read() calls return chunks until exhaustion; trace_log_path is either None or a filesystem path at which a file may be opened for writing in UTF-8 encoding
post_condition: stream is closed; if trace_log_path is not None, a file exists at trace_log_path containing the concatenation of every byte read from stream before exhaustion, the file is closed, and its content is UTF-8 encoded with unencodable characters replaced; if trace_log_path is None, no file is created; stream is closed and (if opened) the trace log file is closed under all execution paths, including when an exception is raised during reading or writing
